decisions.reason: It was still listed after launch and, as a software-based complement to the firm's secure communications offering, it is relatively cheap to keep alive while demand remains somewhat uncertain.
Its promotion to a dedicated page by 2019 suggests stronger early traction and strategic fit with the firm's core cybersecurity capabilities, so the option value of continuing is high.

Although it gained a dedicated page, a hardware signature token is costlier and less core for a medium German software consultancy, and by 2022 uncertainty should be resolved enough to exit if it has not clearly scaled.

A payment-security compliance suite fits the firm's B2B security and consulting base, and even with only modest visibility it is likely worth retaining as a service-linked option with manageable carrying costs.
